en:
My teacher had come t'watch the game,
and I just about died of embarrassment.
So that's the whole story.

I know back at the bar I said I was afraid
of seein' my teacher old and changed....

But what I'm really scared of is
showin' how little I've changed myself.

The dumb kid who bragged about
makin' the major leagues someday...

...Ended up in a dead-end office job
and hangs out at a bar all day long.

I'm sure my teacher's gonna be
pretty disappointed t'hear it.

That's what was weighing you down?
But you're wrong, you know.

Your teacher will probably be happy
to find a student who still cares so much.

Even just coming to say hello
will go a long way.

Nothing makes a teacher happier
than seeing a student doing well.
You... really think so?

I'd be willing to bet you going to
visit meant more than the baseball game.

Well, you'll see when you get older.
Just go to your reunion already.

Ya make some fine points, Kiryu-san.
I was gettin' worked up over nothing.

Well, I oughta get goin'!
Thanks for the pep talk!
Sure, and also...

Remember, baseball is a team sport.
A loss is never the fault of one guy.
You don't have to carry that burden anymore.
You're right. Thanks!

Yo, how was the reunion?
Were you able to talk to your teacher?

Yeah, we were real happy to see each other!
It was a great time! I'm glad I went.
See? Didn't we say it'd be fine?

Teach even told me to get back into
playing baseball again!

Really? That's great. It seems you have
new memories to replace the bad ones.

If y'wanna field some balls, y'oughta
join our team then, right Kiryu-san?
You guys play baseball?

It's just for fun, but would you want in?
We could use your experience.

Really? I've love to join up! Maybe
I'll make a clutch play for my teacher!

Great, then I'll look for you out on
the field then, Akiyoshi-san.

By the way, my teacher was just as suave as
I remember him. I hope I'm that manly someday...
Yeah, as manly as... Eh?

Wait, this teacher of yours...
He's a guy?

Huh? 'Course he is? Who wouldn't
admire such a great guy?
Drinks're on you tonight.
Wait, what? Why?

You led us on! We thought you were
talkin' 'bout romancing a female teacher!
Course not! What gave ya that idea!?

You're dense as a doornail.
Stick to baseball from now on.
Aw, c'mon...

Gen-san went into the bar.
Maybe I should drop by too.
Welcome, Kiryu-san.
Oh, Kiryu-san you came by!
<symbol=note_with_outline> Kick on back <symbol=note_with_outline> Kiryu-san <symbol=note_with_outline>
Just my welcome-back-Kiryu-san song.

If you're gonna break out into song,
use the new karaoke machine I bought.

Karaoke, huh? About that...
I got a bone t'pick with ya, Mama...
Yer mad? Why?

(Hmm, I didn't add to the conversation
and it ended awkwardly.)

(They're still in the bar. I should
clear my head and get back in there.)

Gen-san... You're an incredible singer.
I'm pretty floored.

You just realized that, Kiryu-san?
I gots the best voice in town.

It was super fun, though. All of my
favorite songs are on that machine.
I'd need more throats to sing 'em all.

Heh, I'm glad you enjoyed yourself.
Technology isn't so bad, right?
Yer right.

Not that I can really talk.
I don't keep up with tech either.
Well, yer better off than me fer sure.

I hate on gadgets 'cause it feels like
I'm gettin' left behind in the past.

But ya'll showed me jus' how wrong
about that I was.

It was my own fear of change keepin'
me stuck in the past.

Then all you need to do is catch up.
It's never too late for that.
I guess so... You're right.

Maybe I'll start by buyin' one of those
newfangled smartphone thingies.
They're all high tech and convenient, yeah?

Yeah, I've got one myself,
so I could give you a few tips.

Really!? I'll be countin' on ya then,
Kiryu-san!

Well, no time like the present.
I'm off to the store to buy one! See ya!
Y-Yeah. See you later.
Man, he's kind of impulsive.

But I'm glad he's past his fear of using
that new karaoke machine.

Hm? An email from Gen-san...
Did he just send me a selfie!?

Guess he already mastered his new phone.
If he's at the bar, maybe I'll drop by.
Yo Kiryu-san, check it out!

Hey Gen-san, looks like you're already
using your smartphone.
Piece of cake!

He's been playing with his new toy since
he got here. He's like a little kid.

It's jus' so amazing. You can do
anything with it. Right, Kiryu-san?
Yeah, smartphones are convenient.

The GPS can tell you the weather. It'll
even navigate y'anywhere you wanna go!
Wow, that is certainly convenient.

It can even stream high quality music.
Oh Kiryu-san, I wanted to ask something.
Huh? S-Sure... What about?

I'm gonna buy a Bluetooth headset to
listen to music. Any recommendations?
(Blue... Tooth?)
Ah, no... I don't know much about that yet...

Darn. Well, lemme know if you find a good one.
Man, the service is weak in the bar...

Hey Mama, install some Wi-Fi in here!
Speed is king in the information age!
(Wi... Fi?)

Yeah, yeah. I'll get to it.
Talk about divin' in the deep end...

Heh... Well I guess there's nothing
left for me to teach you...

Not that I taught you anything
to begin with...
All right! Let's do some karaoke!
Gen-san's gone wild!

All right, I'm gonna sing a lot today. 
It'll be a 12-hour duet with Mama!

No way, I'd throw my voice out
before I got halfway through that!

Oh fine, fine. Let's start with
my jam, then... Today is a Diamond!

Anyway... I'm glad Gen-san
got his love of karaoke back.

Yeah, I was a little worried,
but that's passed now.

It can get quiet in here without
Gen-san singin'.
Heh, it's a really lively bar.

How's it going? You an expert at
using the karaoke machine yet?

I've got it down completely! Started a
member account so it's even easier now.

I'm kinda conflicted about him
knowin' more about it than me now...
Really? That's something.

I haven't been gettin' as much exercise
lately though, and it's affectin' my voice.

Hmm, true. It doesn't seem t'carry
quite like it used to.
So, I wanted to talk to you Kiryu-san...
Hm? What about?

You run a baseball team, right?
Got room on the team fer me?
You wanna join up?

Yeah, I'll get my body movin' with some
baseball and take my voice back!

I've got confidence in my skills.
How 'bout it?

I can see that. Of course we'll take you.
I expect some big hits, Gen-san.

You know it! Thanks.
Can't wait to play ball with you, Kiryu-san.
Oh, it's you, Kiryu-san.

I was thinkin' I'd head to the bar.
Care to join me?

I wouldn't mind, but don't you
need to tend your pawn shop?

Y'could hear a pin drop in there
this time o' day, so I figure, why not?

'Scuse me, are you t'owner of that
Otafuku pawn shop?
What? Yeah, that's me...

There's somethin' I need y'to buy.
Are ya closed fer the day?

Ahhhh... Sure, sure.
Stop in and I'll appraise it fer ya.
Oh, really? Much obliged.

I know I invited y'out, Kiryu-san,
but y'mind waiting at my shop?
Th-This ring...!
Huh? What is it?

Ah... Nothing, sorry. It's engraved,
so that drops the value to 10,000 yen.

What a chintzy-ass ring.
But fine, I'll take 10k.

What's the matter, Ando-san?
You're kind of pale.

N-No, I'm fine. Sorry, Kiryu-san. Y'mind
if I let ya head to the bar by yerself?

That's fine...
Don't push yourself too hard, okay?

Something felt off about Ando-san.
I'll ask what happened at the bar.
I better not bother Ando-san right now.

Ando-san said he'll be coming later. 
Should I go on inside ahead of him?
Yeah, I'll wait.
No, maybe another time.
Oh, Kiryu-san! All alone?

No, Ando-san should be coming in a bit.
He seemed really down about something...
Oh, that sounds bad.
We'll get to the bottom of this yet.

Welcome, Ando-san...
...Yeah, he's down in the dumps.

C'mon, sit yerself down.
We'll hear ya out.
I hope Ando-san cheers up soon...
I'll drop by Otafuku Pawn later.

I'm worried about Ando-san right now.
I should head to Otafuku Pawn.
Hm? There's a note.

What's this? "I'll be closing up shop for a while..."
What?
Hey, wait, he ain't recovered at all!
H-Hatakeyama-san... You all came!
Well, we're all worried about Ando-san too.
Even after we were extra nice to him...
Nah, y'were yer regular self, Mama.

Um, excuse me... Is there a shop
called Otafuku Pawn around here?

Oh, that's the place right there, but
the business is closed down for now.

What!? Closed down...
But where's Ando, the owner?

That's what we want to know...
Who are ya exactly, Miss?

I'm... Ando's ex-wife, Koharu! Sorry for any
trouble my husb<symbol=em_dash_with_outline>my ex caused you.
Whaaaaaat!?
You and Ando-san...?

Lady... Y'even realize what you've done?
Ando-san is a right mess over you!

Y'made your new man sell Ando's ring after ya
cut off all communication with him!?

Now, now, Mama.
I understand how y'feel, but...

Sell his ring...? Um, I'm sorry,
but who are all of you to Ando...?
Just his drinkin' buddies.

Drinking buddies... So Ando made some
friends who genuinely care about him.

Anyway, can you tell us more about you?
Anything that might help, maybe about the ring.
Y-Yes, the truth is...
Your bag was stolen!?

Yes...
I arrived in Onomichi just this morning.

Ando kept calling to say how he's become a
new man, and my curiosity got the better of me...
Ando-san, such a passionate guy.

But after I arrived in Onomichi, my bag was
snatched while I was looking for his shop...
And your wedding ring was in there?

Yes. Even after I divorced Ando,
I couldn't get rid of the ring...

I've never really come to terms with leaving
him... That's why I came all this way...

Ando-san said he regretted making 
you feel lonely in your marriage.

He has such a strong sense of responsibility.
It made him a total workaholic...

He got so comfortable in that lifestyle,
he never tried to make any friends.

To be fair, Ando-san doesn't particularly
enjoy talkin' to new people at the bar either.
I'd say he's still a tough nut t'crack.

But to think he'd have friends who worry about
him this much... I'm still surprised.

Wait. So yer sayin' you and Ando could
maybe rekindle yer marriage?
O-Oh... Well, uh...

Then the guy who sold the ring was a thief.
Both Koharu-san and Ando-san were victims here.

Then we've gotta find Ando-san! If we miss him,
he could end up halfway 'round the world!

Th-That's right!
Let's split up and search.

Do you want to come with me?
You probably don't know the area that well.
That's true. Sorry for the inconvenience...
Th-Thief!!! Help!
Hm? That guy...
Outta my way, old man!
Heh... Looks like you hit a dead end.
Gah...!
Y-You're the thief...!

You're the one who stole Koharu's
bag and pawned off the ring.

What's the matter, Kiryu-san!?
I heard yelling.

Oh, Hatakeyama-san...
I just caught the purse snatcher.
What!? This guy here!?

Yeah, but where's Ando-san?
Any luck finding him?

Oh, yeah. The granny at the cigarette shop
saw Ando-san going toward the shore!
The seashore... Let's go.

He's got that faraway stare...
Glad we found him 'fore he went on a pilgrimage.

Hey... Does he look like he's windin'
up t'throw somethin'?

Oh come on, what is he gonna throw the ring
and yell "Idiot!" like some cheesy drama?
Wait! Don't!
Wha...? Koharu? Why...?
...Thank god...

Koharu, y'really came all the way back...
...To say goodbye.
No, you're wrong!

Whaddaya mean, I'm wrong?
I can't take any more false hope!

Y'ripped my heart out,
sellin' that ring...

That's not true!
A thief stole the ring. This fool.

Kiryu-san... And that customer...
What do you mean it was stolen?

Koharu-san took care of yer ring even
after the divorce. She was bringing it back t'ya!

Her bag was snatched along the way, and the 
thief coincidentally took the ring to your store.

I'm sorry letting my guard down
caused you so much pain...

It was stolen... I can't believe it...
Wait, did he hurt ya? Are y'okay?
I'm fine...

I'm glad... I'm sorry I made Kiryu-san
and everyone else worried, too...

Don't worry about it. Just a bit of bad luck.
Well, maybe it was good luck in the end.

To be honest... I just wanted to see you
working away happily before going home.

That's not what I ended up seeing...
I saw something more wonderful.
More wonderful?

You've made some great friends.
They were all so worried about you.

I even got a scolding from the mama.
She said Ando-san deserves better.

Okay, now I'm kinda embarrassed...
Kyaa!
Kyaa? Really?

When we were in Tokyo, I was all you had.
This city changed you for the better.
